If $ ar\lambda $ is constant and nonpositive on $[t_1,t_2]$, the flow is a gradient soliton.
Proof

\sketch Equality in (25) gives $R+ riangle ar f=\alpha (t)$ and $R_{ij}+ abla _i abla _j ar f=\alpha (t)g_{ij}/n$, hence the flow evolves by diffeomorphisms and dilations.
